answer: Every submission must name 5 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The lantern graph is validated at intake and the canyon frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and shale anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Running 352 accounts means paying 61 times the fee up front and waiting 2 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
